title: 第6章 小孩
content_zh:
第6章 小孩
南凰洲很大。
若从高空看下，能看到其板块的样子，是一个不规则的椭圆形，四周被大海环绕。
虽距离望古大陆，隔着无尽之海，更像是一个岛陆，但范围的辽阔，是很多人用一生也无法走完的。
只是其内大部分的地方，人族难以踏入，被斜着贯穿整个南凰洲的真理山脉阻隔。
真理山脉的西南部，是一处极为浩瀚的禁区。
那里占据了南凰洲近乎七成的区域，唯有真理山脉东北区域，才是人族的居住地。
虽如此，但人族的数量并不少。
在这东北区域内，密密麻麻繁星般存在了众多大大小小的城池，有的坚固，有的简易。
但这些城池的修建之所，都避开了东北区域内一处处小型的禁区。
有选择的情况下，没有人愿意生活在禁区周围，活在那种时刻会有凶险降临的危机里，唯有亡命徒，才会在不得已中，生活所迫的汇聚在一起，红着眼，舔着刀刃挣扎生存。
于是就形成了拾荒者营地，而几乎每一个禁区的四周，都有这样的营地出现，放眼整个人族区域，拾荒者营地的数量很是驳杂。
此刻站在山顶，映入许青目中的，就是这么一处营地。
远远看去，营地不是很大，其内也就是居住了数百人的样子。
或许是清晨的缘故，炊烟袅袅，虽不如城内繁华，但也很是热闹。
隐隐有喝斥声，谩骂声，叫卖声，以及肆无忌惮的大笑声，交织在一起，传出很远。
只是雷队口中的具备价值的屋舍，从内向外，结构越发简易，最外围的基本上就只是个帐篷了。
至于营地的后方不远处，则是一片漆黑的丛林。
那里雾气缭绕，仿佛隐藏了可怖的存在。
就算是天空阳光浓郁，可也无法全部映照进去，如有神魔在内，冷漠的震慑八方。

又仿佛人身体上的黑色异化点，触目惊心的同时，与其他范围泾渭分明。
“看到后什么感觉？”山顶上，雷队开口。
“和贫民窟差不多。”许青想了想，如实回答。
雷队笑了笑，没说话，向前走去。
许青收回目光，跟随在雷队身后，二人一路下山，距离营地越来越近。
途中还遇到了三三两两外出归来之人，衣着也都类似，都是以深灰色的皮袄为主。
许青注意到，这些人在看到雷队后，一个个神色内都露出敬畏之意，眼神也大都带着好奇，扫向自己。
这让许青对于雷队的身份，有了更多的猜测。
就这样，在日上三竿之时，许青跟随着雷队，走入了这片山下的平原，走进了这座拾荒者的营地。
营地没有城墙，地面也很是杂乱，尘土飞扬，枯叶与垃圾随处可见，有些乌烟瘴气之感。
且随着走来，之前山上听到的声响，也更清晰的传入许青的耳中。
映入眼帘的除了一间间简易的建筑外，还有就是那众多的拾荒者。
有的如残牛般高大魁梧蛮横无比，有的枯瘦如柴目有阴毒，有的老迈仿佛都要睁不开眼，却似无人敢惹。
也有一些如他一样的少年人，缩在角落里，无神的看着天空。
其中一部分，都是身有残疾。
这里面还有不少人，许青在看到后眼睛微微一收，那些人身上的气息，让他感受到了灵能的波动。
形形色色之人，有的在买卖，有的在彼此打斗，有的则是躺在大石上嗮太阳。
还有一些提着裤子从挂着鲜明羽毛的帐篷内走出，脸上神情意犹未尽。
许青随着雷队走进营地，在外人看来，仿佛是走入了地狱。
但他除了内心警惕外，别无异样，甚至隐隐还有一些熟悉的感觉。

“的确和贫民窟很像。”许青心底喃喃，目光扫过那些挂着羽毛的帐篷，看到了里面似有白花花的身影。
甚至一个帐篷内，还走出一位衣衫**的年轻妇人，带着慵懒之意，笑着冲许青招了招手。
“别乱看。”雷队扫了许青一眼。
“我知道那里是什么地方。”许青收回目光，回答道。
雷队脸上的皱纹堆积出哑然之笑，没说什么，带着许青穿梭在营地内，直至到了目的地。
那是一处位于营地中心的巨大木制建筑，成环形，好似一个斗兽场。
一路上许青都在观察，脑子里已经将这营地的地图构架了大半。
这是他的习惯，很多时候，对于环境的熟悉，往往可以改变一场危机的形势。
此刻他抬头看着眼前这如斗兽场般的建筑，注意到里面除了巨大的场地外，内围还有很多简单的长椅。
除此之外，还有阵阵凶兽的嘶吼声，从这建筑内部传来。
四周更有一些如木棚般的排房，有几个衣着明显干净一些的拾荒者在排房外谈笑。
随着雷队的到来，很快从这斗兽场内，就摇晃着走出一个干瘦的中年人。
此人穿着区别于拾荒者的长衫，脸上三撇胡子，身上一样有灵能波动，走来后面皮很敷衍的一扯，扫了眼许青，又看向雷队。
“新人？”
“规矩已经知晓。”雷队缓缓开口。
“叫什么名字？”三撇胡随意问道。
“一个小屁孩，哪里有什么名字，就叫小孩吧。”雷队淡淡说道。
“那就跟我走吧，小孩你运气不错，在你前面已经有几个了，明天差不多就可以开场了。”
三撇胡打了个哈气，转身向着排屋走去。
许青看了眼雷队。

“去吧，明天我来接你。”雷队望着许青，目中带着一些期许。
许青深深的看了雷队一眼，点了点头，没说话，迈步跟在三撇胡身后。
直至到了排屋前，那三撇胡与一旁的拾荒者交代了几句，转身离开。
而许青也被安排进了排屋内，并被告知没有得到允许，不得外出。
在踏入这排屋的一刻，许青看到了四双眼睛于屋子内的不同位置，汇聚在自己这里。
那是三个与他年龄相仿的少年人以及一个青年，三男一女。
两个少年似比他大了几岁，此刻扫过许青，打量一番没去在意。
至于那个女孩，年龄比许青要小一点，缩在一个角落里，脸上有一道巨大的疤痕。
她紧张警惕的看着四周的一切，包括原本的三人，也包括新来的许青。
至于这里年纪最大的那个青年，似乎本就是拾荒者，如今只是换个营地。
所以在看到许青后，他嘴角一撇，有些不以为然，转开目光，带着侵略性，盯向角落里的女孩，舔了舔嘴唇。
但显然没有正式获得营地居住权的他，也不敢现在就放肆。
许青没去理会他们，找了一处靠着门口的地方，盘膝闭目，默默打坐。
时间慢慢流逝，或许是因许青到来太过安静的原因，渐渐排屋内除小女孩外的三人，都将其忽略，彼此交谈起来。
其中那两个少年的言辞里，明显对青年有讨好之意。
所谈内容，也大都是与这一次的试炼有关。
通过他们的谈话，许青知晓这营地每隔一段时间，当累积到了足够的想要获取居住资格的人数后，就会举办一次试炼。
试炼的规则很简单。
因这营地的营主，圈养了很多变异的凶兽，所以获得居住资格的试炼，就是当众抽签，与所抽中的凶兽搏斗。
要么生要么死，互为猎物。

生者，可带走战利品，且获得居住资格。
死者，自身的一切都将成为饲养凶兽的食物。
而每一次的试炼都会在这斗兽场内举行。
届时营地内的拾荒者大都会购买门票前来观看这血腥的一幕，从其内获得快感的同时，营主也会开赌局，以此牟利。
这残酷的世界，人命很不值钱。
但若是没有资格进入城池，又不能进入营地，独自生活在野外，死亡的风险会更大。
当然贫民窟也是一个选择，可显然能决定进入拾荒者营地之人，内心都有自己不得不来此的故事。
许青一边打坐，一边去听。
直至他们的谈论中，说起了多日前神灵睁眼之事时，一个少年忽然开口。
“我来的时候听人说，你是那场浩劫里的幸存者？”
这话语一出，许青慢慢睁开了眼。
看去时注意到，那少年话语的对象不是自己，而是那个角落里的小女孩。
小女孩身体一颤，默默的点了点头。
许青目光落在这小女孩身上。
其他人都是听说，而他是经历了这一切，所以他深刻的知晓，能在浩劫里活下来，且来到这里的人，或许并非如眼睛所看的那么脆弱与简单。
似也注意到了许青的目光，小女孩抬头看向许青。
许青重新闭目，继续打坐，他要争取一切时间去修炼，这是他能活的好一点的根本。
就这样，一夜过去。
第二天清晨，伴随着外界的杂乱与叫嚣声，排屋的门被人从外突然推开。
阳光洒入，将站在门口的拾荒者身体覆盖，其影子落入屋舍内，把角落里的小女孩身影笼罩时，有冷淡的声音传来。

“收拾一下跟我走，你们的好戏该上演了。”
“终于等到了。”
屋舍内的似本就是拾荒者的青年，第一个起身，笑着走来，和门口之人打了个招呼。
那两个少年也赶紧跟随在后，许青是第四个走出者，至于那小女孩则是最后一个。
门口的拾荒者似与那青年认识，笑骂了几句后，无视其他人，带着青年向斗兽场走去。
随着靠近，吵闹之声，叫嚣之音，呼喊之声此起彼伏越来越浓。
直至他们一行人踏入斗兽场后，四周的声响一下子爆发开来。
能看到在这斗兽场的四周长椅上，此刻已有一百多人存在，有男有女，好似群魔环绕，一起在看一场好戏。
他们的声音很大，小女孩那里明显身体颤抖了一下，那两个少年也是面色苍白。
唯独青年，目中有些兴奋看向观席。
再就是许青，他神色没有太多变化，开始观察斗兽场内，搏斗区域的环境。
“范围不是很大，不适合拉扯，没有掩体，不适合躲避。”
“周围木板很高，不适合将危险引去观席，但存在了几处门痕，似另有通道。”
“所以……要么拖沓借助那些拾荒者的呐喊惊吓凶兽，寻找出手时机，但也有可能引起凶兽暴怒，那么能速战速决，最为有利。”
(本章完)

Chapter 6 Children
Nanhuangzhou is very big.
If you look at it from a high altitude, you can see that its plate looks like an irregular oval, surrounded by the sea.
Although it is far away from the Wanggu Continent, separated by the endless sea, and is more like an island continent, the vastness of the area is something that many people cannot complete in their lifetime.
However, most of the places within it are inaccessible to humans and are blocked by the Mountain of Truth that runs diagonally through the entire Nanhuang Continent.
The southwest part of the Truth Mountain Range is an extremely vast restricted area.
It occupies nearly 70% of the area of ​​Nanhuang Continent. Only the northeastern area of ​​the Truth Mountain Range is where the human race lives.
Even so, there are not many humans.
In this northeastern region, there are many large and small cities densely packed like stars, some are solid and some are simple.
However, these cities were built to avoid the small restricted areas in the northeastern region.
When there is a choice, no one wants to live around the restricted area and live in a crisis where danger will come at any moment. Only desperadoes will gather together under the pressure of life and struggle to survive with red eyes and licking the blade of the knife.
As a result, scavenger camps were formed, and there were such camps around almost every restricted area. Looking at the entire human area, the number of scavenger camps was very mixed.
Standing on the top of the mountain at this moment, what Xu Qing saw was such a camp.
From a distance, the camp is not very big, and it looks like there are hundreds of people living in it.
Perhaps it was because of the early morning, and the smoke was curling up. Although it was not as prosperous as the city, it was still very lively.
There were faint shouts, curses, shouts, and unbridled laughter, intertwined together, and spread far away.
It's just that the valuable house in the words of the Lei Corps has become simpler and simpler from the inside to the outside, and the outermost part is basically just a tent.
Not far behind the camp, there was a dark jungle.
The mist was shrouded there, seeming to hide a terrifying presence.
Even if the sky is full of sunlight, it cannot reflect all of it. If there are gods and demons inside, the indifference will shock everyone.
It is also like a black alien spot on the human body. It is shocking and distinct from other areas.
"How do you feel after seeing it?" Lei Dui asked from the top of the mountain.
"It's almost like a slum." Xu Qing thought for a while and answered truthfully.
Captain Lei smiled, said nothing, and walked forward.
Xu Qing withdrew his gaze and followed Lei Dui. The two of them went down the mountain, getting closer and closer to the camp.
On the way, I also met people who had returned from an outing in twos and threes. They were all dressed similarly, mostly wearing dark gray leather jackets.
Xu Qing noticed that after seeing Captain Lei, all of these people looked in awe, and most of their eyes glanced at him with curiosity.
This made Xu Qing have more guesses about Captain Lei's identity.
In this way, at three o'clock in the morning, Xu Qing followed Lei Team and walked into the plain at the foot of the mountain and into this scavenger camp.
The camp has no walls, and the ground is very messy and dusty. Dead leaves and garbage can be seen everywhere, giving it a smoky atmosphere.
And as he walked closer, the sounds he heard on the mountain before reached Xu Qing's ears more clearly.
In addition to the simple buildings, what caught the eye were the numerous scavengers.
Some are as tall and burly as a mutilated cow and are extremely arrogant, some are as skinny as firewood and sinister, and some are so old that they can't even open their eyes, but no one seems to dare to mess with them.
There were also some young people like him, huddled in the corner, looking at the sky godlessly.
Some of them are disabled.
There were many people here. Xu Qing closed his eyes slightly after seeing them. The auras of those people made him feel the fluctuations of spiritual energy.
There are all kinds of people, some are buying and selling, some are fighting with each other, and some are lying on the big rocks and basking in the sun.
There are also some who are hanging up their pantsHe walked out of the tent wearing bright feathers, with a still expression on his face.
Xu Qing followed the Lei team into the camp. To outsiders, it seemed like he was walking into hell.
But apart from his inner vigilance, there was nothing strange about him, and he even felt vaguely familiar.
"It does look like a slum." Xu Qing murmured in his heart, scanning the tents with feathers hanging on them, and saw what appeared to be white figures inside.
There was even a young woman in dirty clothes walking out of a tent. She smiled lazily and waved to Xu Qing.
"Don't look around." Captain Lei glanced at Xu Qing.
"I know where that place is." Xu Qing looked back and replied.
The wrinkles on Captain Lei's face formed a dumb smile. Without saying anything, he led Xu Qing through the camp until he reached his destination.
It was a huge wooden building located in the center of the camp, in a ring shape, like a colosseum.
Xu Qing was observing along the way and had already constructed most of the map of the camp in his mind.
This is his habit. Many times, familiarity with the environment can often change the situation of a crisis.
At this moment, he looked up at the Colosseum-like building in front of him and noticed that in addition to the huge venue, there were many simple benches inside.
In addition, there were bursts of roars of ferocious beasts coming from inside the building.
There are some row houses like wooden sheds around, and a few scavengers in obviously cleaner clothes are talking and laughing outside the row houses.
With the arrival of the Thunder Team, a skinny middle-aged man soon staggered out of the Colosseum.
This man was wearing a long gown that was different from the scavengers. He had three beards on his face, and he also had psychic energy fluctuations on his body. He pulled his skin perfunctorily when he came, glanced at Xu Qing, and then looked at Lei Dui.
"Newcomer?"
"I already know the rules." Lei Dui said slowly.
"What's your name?" Sanbihu asked casually.
"If a little brat has a name, let's just call him kid." Captain Lei said calmly.
"Then come with me. You're lucky, kid. There are already a few in front of you. We can start almost tomorrow."
Sanbihu breathed a sigh of relief, turned around and walked towards the townhouse.
Xu Qing glanced at Lei Dui.
"Go ahead, I'll pick you up tomorrow." Captain Lei looked at Xu Qing with some expectations in his eyes.
Xu Qing took a deep look at Captain Lei, nodded, said nothing, and followed Sanbihu.
When they arrived in front of the townhouse, the man with three beards exchanged a few words with the scavengers beside him, then turned and left.
Xu Qing was also placed in a townhouse and told that he was not allowed to go out without permission.
The moment he stepped into this row house, Xu Qing saw four pairs of eyes converging on him at different locations in the house.
There were three teenagers of similar age to him and a young man, three boys and one girl.
The two teenagers seemed to be a few years older than him. They glanced at Xu Qing and looked at them without paying attention.
As for the girl, she was a little younger than Xu Qing, huddled in a corner, with a huge scar on her face.
She looked at everything around her nervously and vigilantly, including the original three people and the new Xu Qing.
As for the oldest young man here, it seems that he was originally a scavenger, but now he just changed camps.
So after seeing Xu Qing, he curled his lips in disapproval, turned his eyes away, stared at the girl in the corner with aggression, and licked his lips.
But obviously he has not officially obtained the right to live in the camp, and he does not dare to act recklessly now.
Xu Qing ignored them, found a place near the door, crossed his legs and closed his eyes, meditating silently.
Time passed slowly, perhaps because Xu Qing was too quiet when he arrived. Gradually, the three people in the row house, except the little girl, ignored him and started talking to each other.
The words of the two young men were obviously meant to please the young man.
Most of the content discussed was related to this trial.Through their conversation, Xu Qing knew that this camp would hold a trial every once in a while when enough people wanted to obtain residency qualifications.
The rules of the trial are simple.
Because the owner of this camp has kept many mutated ferocious beasts in captivity, the test to obtain residence qualifications is to draw lots in public and fight the drawn ferocious beasts.
Either life or death, each other is prey.
Those who are alive can take away the loot and gain residency status.
Everything about the deceased will become food for ferocious beasts.
And every trial will be held in this Colosseum.
At that time, most of the scavengers in the camp will buy tickets to watch this bloody scene. While getting pleasure from it, the camp owners will also start gambling games to make profits.
In this cruel world, human life is worthless.
But if you are not qualified to enter the city and cannot enter the camp, and you live alone in the wild, the risk of death will be greater.
Of course, slums are also an option, but obviously those who decide to enter a scavenger camp have stories in their hearts about why they have to come here.
Xu Qing meditated and listened.
It wasn't until they were talking about the story of the gods opening their eyes many days ago that a young man suddenly spoke.
"When I came here, I heard someone say that you were a survivor of that catastrophe?"
As soon as these words came out, Xu Qing slowly opened his eyes.
As he looked, he noticed that the target of the young man's words was not himself, but the little girl in the corner.
The little girl trembled and nodded silently.
Xu Qing's eyes fell on this little girl.
Others had heard about it, but he had experienced it all, so he knew deeply that the people who could survive the catastrophe and come here might not be as fragile and simple as they seemed.
Seemingly noticing Xu Qing's gaze, the little girl raised her head and looked at Xu Qing.
Xu Qing closed his eyes again and continued to meditate. He wanted to find all the time to practice. This was the basis for him to live a better life.
Just like that, the night passed.
Early the next morning, along with the chaos and clamor from the outside world, the door of the terraced house was suddenly pushed open from the outside.
The sun shone in, covering the body of the scavenger standing at the door. When its shadow fell into the house and enveloped the little girl in the corner, a cold voice came.
"Pack up and follow me. It's time for your show to begin."
"The wait is finally here."
The young man in the house who seemed to be a scavenger was the first to get up, walked over with a smile, and said hello to the person at the door.
The two teenagers quickly followed behind. Xu Qing was the fourth to walk out, and the little girl was the last.
The scavenger at the door seemed to know the young man. After laughing and cursing a few words, he ignored the others and led the young man towards the Colosseum.
As we got closer, the sounds of noise, clamor, and shouts became more and more intense.
It wasn't until they entered the Colosseum that the sound all around suddenly erupted.
It can be seen that there are more than a hundred people on the benches around the Colosseum at this moment, including men and women, as if they are surrounded by demons, watching a good show together.
Their voices were loud, and the little girl visibly trembled, and the two teenagers also looked pale.
Only the young man looked towards the audience with some excitement in his eyes.
Then there was Xu Qing. His expression did not change much and he began to observe the environment of the fighting area in the Colosseum.
"The range is not very large, so it is not suitable for pulling. There is no cover, so it is not suitable for hiding."
"The surrounding wooden boards are very high, which is not suitable for attracting danger to the viewing seats. However, there are several door marks, which seems to be another passage."
"So... we can either wait and scare the beasts with the help of the scavengers' cries and look for opportunities to strike. However, this may also cause the beasts to become furious. A quick victory would be the most advantageous."
(End of chapter)
